# Eagle Eye P.I. - Comprehensive Agency Knowledge Base (LLMS-Full)

> Eagle Eye P.I. is a premier licensed private investigation and executive protection agency headquartered at 576 Central Ave, East Orange, NJ 07018. Serving all 21 counties in New Jersey and all 5 boroughs of New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, The Bronx, Staten Island), plus Long Island and Westchester County. Led by Francesco, a retired U.S. Department of Justice and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) ICE veteran with over 25 years of federal law enforcement experience.

## Complete Service Catalog & Methodologies

1. Covert Surveillance: High-definition physical and mobile surveillance utilizing 4K optical and night-vision telemetry. Court-admissible video and photographic proof for legal and personal disputes.
2. Infidelity & Matrimonial: Discreet domestic investigations to uncover partner infidelity, hidden financial assets, and child custody compliance.
3. Digital Sweeps (TSCM): Counter-surveillance technical security countermeasures utilizing Andre near-field transmission detection kits to locate hidden cameras, audio bugs, and wiretaps.
4. Executive Protection: Close-proximity personal security details conducted by retired federal and tactical officers for corporate executives, diplomats, and high-risk individuals.
5. Armed Chauffeur Services: Secure, defensively trained armed transport throughout the New York metropolitan area and New Jersey for VIPs and high-value cargo transport.
6. Attorney & Litigation Support: Trial preparation, witness locates, recorded statements, and courtroom-admissible evidence gathering for civil and criminal defense lawyers.
7. Insurance Fraud Investigation: Claimant verification, staged accident analysis, and activity checks to protect commercial carriers from fraudulent payouts.
8. Workers' Compensation Fraud: Documenting undisclosed employment or physical activities inconsistent with claimed workplace disabilities.
9. Criminal Background & Screening: Deep-dive criminal history vetting, civil litigation checks, and pre-employment screening beyond standard public databases.
10. Missing Person & Skip Tracing: Locating runaway youth, estranged relatives, evasive debtors, and hard-to-find witnesses using former Fugitive Task Force methodologies.
11. Fleet & Asset GPS Tracking: Lawful real-time GPS tracking solutions and unauthorized tracker detection on personal or commercial fleet vehicles.
12. Social Media & OSINT: Open-source intelligence (OSINT) and digital footprint preservation to uncover online evidence, cyber harassment, or hidden relationships.
13. Process Serving: Prompt, legally compliant service of subpoenas, summonses, complaints, and court documents across New Jersey and New York.
14. Court & Public Record Retrieval: Fast retrieval of county, state, and federal court filings, property deeds, vital statistics, and corporate registrations.
15. Notary Public Services: Certified notarization for affidavits, sworn investigative statements, legal contracts, and sensitive documentation.

## Leadership & Federal Pedigree
